newsitem.title: GERMANY: Oil World sees low Canada canola crush in Jan/Feb.
newsitem.headline: Oil World sees low Canada canola crush in Jan/Feb.

text.p: Crushings of Canadian canola (rapeseed) should stay low in January and February, the Oil World newsletter said on Tuesday.
Crushings in November and December fell by eight and 16 percent respectively from a year earlier.
Citing tight supplies and high prices, it said crushers were shunning canola in favour of soybeans, where margins were more favourable and crush volumes were set to stay high.
The trend would change only if export demand for canola oil picked up, Oil World said.

Canadian Oilseed Processors Association figures showed canola crushings in the week ended January 8 were 40,381 tonnes after 41,700 in the week ended January 1 and 44,109 tonnes in the week ended December 18.
Oil World said total December 1996 canola crushings were 200,00 tonnes, down from 238,000 tonnes in Dec 1995.
